## Definition of Done

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (types, lint, format, unit and engine tests)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (corpus fixture for any detection change)
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard-only pass, light and dark, 320 px panel width
- [ ] No new permissions, or the plan and Web Store justification are updated
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if the architecture changed
